messages:
Diego: hey everyone, day 2 here — trying to get a personal token to test a staging feature flag toggle. Console -> My tokens isn't showing the Create button for me. any ideas?
Maya: welcome! sometimes new accounts need the "token:create" claim from Okta. people-ops usually adds it during onboarding. did you get the onboarding checklist email?
Diego: yes got it, but it said Okta group assignment was pending. how can I check which claims I have?
Maya: go to https://console.internal/me -> at the bottom there's a claims section showing groups/roles. or run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SSO_TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/me` to see claims.
Diego: curl shows role: "user" and groups: []. no token:create. who do I ping to speed this up?
Maya: open a people-ops ticket with subject "Okta claim: token:create for Diego" and include your okta UID. cc @infra if you need a temporary workaround.
infra: if you need a short test token before claims propagate, we can issue a 1-hour dev token. please attach the ticket and specify the flag name and reason.
Diego: filing people-ops ticket now, also requesting a 1h dev token from infra. thanks!
access-bot: People-ops request PO-612 created by Diego. Infra dev token request INF-221 created and queued. Status: pending :hourglass:
Maya: once you have the token, use Console > Flags -> select flag -> API tab for curl examples. remember to include a rollback plan if you're toggling staging flags that other teams rely on.
Diego: noted. appreciate the quick help :)
